But there is another circumstance of great importance in the view of economy. The business of 합중국 has hitherto occupied the State 입법부s, as well as 의회. The latter has made requisitions which the former have had to provide for. Hence it has happened that the sessions of the State 입법부s have been protracted greatly beyond what was necessary for the execution of the mere local business of the States. More than half their time has been frequently employed in matters which related to 합중국. Now the members who compose the 입법부s of the several States amount to two thousand and upwards, which number has hitherto performed what under the new system will be done in the first instance by sixty-five persons, and probably at no future period by above a fourth or fifth of that number. The 의회 under the proposed 정부 will do all the business of 합중국 themselves, without the intervention of the State 입법부s, who thenceforth will have only to attend to the affairs of their particular States, and will not have to sit in any proportion as long as they have heretofore done. This difference in the time of the sessions of the State 입법부s will be clear gain, and will alone form an article of saving, which may be regarded as an equivalent for any additional objects of expense that may be occasioned by the adoption of the new system.

The result from these observations is that the sources of additional expense from the establishment of the 제안된 헌법 are much fewer than may have been imagined; that they are counterbalanced by considerable objects of saving; and that while it is questionable on which side the scale will preponderate, it is certain that a 정부 less expensive would be incompetent to the purposes of the Union.

3. To show that there is a power in the Constitution by which the 자유 of the press may be affected, recourse has been had to the power of 과세.
